Name: Sauvignon in Stardew
Author: Jdvicks94
Description:
[b][u]Uses SMAPI

Built for Stardew Valley 1.3 - Up to date!

Does not work in multiplayer[/u][/b][b][u] - Apparently works in multiplayer to an extent

[/u][/b]Extract 'Sauvignon in Stardew' folder into your Game's Mod folder.

[u][b]Current:

[/b][/u][list]
[*][u][b] ﻿[/b][/u]Adds Winery Building to the Carpenter Menu
[/list][list=1]
[*]﻿Purchase from Robin for 40,000 Gold, 200 Hardwood, 100 Clay, and 100 Stone. Takes 4 days to construct. 11x6 building. [b]Has seasonal textures[/b]. Features a walk through archway.
[*]﻿Casks can be used inside the building. Casks & Kegs inside the building work 30% faster. On mouse over, they display the product inside ﻿and show time/days remaining.
[*][i][b]NEW FEATURE[/b][/i] Adds a lovely track of music inside the Winery.

[/list][list]
[*] Adds Distiller Profession - [i][b]NEW FEATURE [/b][/i]Option to turn it off in the new Config file. [b]Set it to false if you only want the building[/b].
[/list][list=1]
[*]﻿All alcohol (Wines, Beers, Meads, IPAs, etc.) are [b]their own Category[/b] called Distilled Craft. They [b]no longer get the 40% sell bonus[/b] from the ﻿Artisan Profession.
[*]﻿Distiller Profession [b]stems from Level 5 Tiller Profession[/b]. At Level 10 Farming, you can now choose between Artisan, Agriculturist, or ﻿Distiller.
[*]Distiller Profession gives you a 40% sell bonus on all alcohol (the new Distilled Craft category).

[/list]

[u][b]Future:

[/b][/u][i]Currently working on international language integration. And working towards a big 2.0 update which should feature a building upgrade and some big ol keggos. Thanks for sticking with me everyone!!![/i]

Feel free to report any errors with the mod here on nexus mods or on the DM me on discord @Jesse#0358

Open Source at https://github.com/JDvickery/Sauvignon-in-Stardew
